title: Pure Mist Sensation Menthol 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Sensation Menthol delivers an intensified Menthol experience, combining the clean, crisp flavour of Menthol with an extra-icy finish. This bold and refreshing e-liquid is perfect for vapers who crave a stronger cooling sensation in their vape. The Pure Mist High-PG collection offers a variety of VG/PG ratios to cater to different preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more intense flavour with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Menthol Sensation is crafted in the UK with high-quality ingredients to ensure a consistent and invigorating vaping experience.
